svg.title: GainSec — the living archive
svg.desc: A night city that is one researcher's archive, seen in a single 3:24 journey that loops. The camera starts far above the skyline, where the name GainSec is part of the architecture, descends into the project district and zooms through a window of each building into a laboratory where the same researcher (a man of about thirty with short black hair and a five-o'clock shadow) is at work: AutoProber (Robotics and Hardware Laboratory); Treehouse Defense System (RF Observation Tower); BirdShot (Security Research Facility); DWARF (Adversarial Testing Chamber); ArcticBase + AgentReadyArmor (AI Operations Center); Super Awesome AI Driver (Robotics Garage); SectorMap (Data Visualization Observatory). It then travels through the older Beyond GitHub district, one building per group of publications, each lit window standing for one publication and each room holding a board that pages through that group's titles: SectorGov, 2; Flock Safety Research, 12; Verkada / Verkracked Research, 3; Other Connected Public Safety + Surveillance Research, 1; Automotive, V2X + Connected Infrastructure, 3; Hardware + Embedded Security, 4; Software Vulnerability Disclosures, 9; OSINT Research, 4; Project Releases + Engineering, 20; Technical Walkthroughs, 45; Technical Leadership, 3; Lectures, Papers + Media, 8 — 114 in all. Finally it rises above the city again, where the districts light up one after another, and returns to the opening view. No sound; nothing depends on interaction.
